name: natDegree_basis
statement: Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) : (Lagrange.basis s v i).natDegree = #s - 1

have_tree.name: H
have_tree.type: ∀ j, j ∈ s.erase i → basisDivisor (v i) (v j) ≠ 0

name: interpolate_eq_sum_interpolate_insert_sdiff
statement: Set.InjOn v t) (hs : s.Nonempty) (hst : s ⊆ t) : interpolate t v r = ∑ i ∈ s, interpolate (insert i (t \ s)) v r * Lagrange.basis s v i

name: iterate_derivative_interpolate
statement: Set.InjOn v s) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < #s) : derivative^[k] (interpolate s v r) = k.factorial * ∑ i ∈ s, C (r i / ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (v i - v j)) * ∑ t ∈ (s.erase i).powersetCard (#s - (k + 1)), ∏ a ∈ t, (X - C (v a))

name: _root_.Polynomial.exists_eval_eq_iff
statement: Type*} [Finite ι] (x y : ι → F) : (∃ q : F[X], ∀ i, q.eval (x i) = y i) ↔ ∀ i j, x i = x j → y i = y j
